requirements.evidence: Both components, routes (routes/web.php:59-60), nav links (default-page.blade.php:49-56), tabs with role="tablist" and setActiveTab whitelist (Members.php:65-72), all contract lang keys in both locales, scoped findOrFail everywhere, slug re-derived on rename (Queues.php:133 `slug: Str::slug($newName)`), confirmation modal instead of wire:confirm, callNext exception handling and rate limit (Serve.php:384-414). Gaps: closeQueue() (Queues.php:94-101) does not reset accessQueueId/managingAccess though the task says 'every nested state'; an invalid client-set `mode` makes CallMode::from throw a ValueError (500) instead of being rejected.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket and policies are used, but: no Pest tests at all despite 'No production code without a test'; no #[Validate] on `name`, `renameName`, `mode`, `selectedQueueId` (Queues.php:26-36, Serve.php:27-34); helper methods callableQueues/waitingTickets/selectedQueue/viewingQueue are public (Serve.php:325,343,377; Queues.php:209) against rule 5; no CHANGELOG/docs updates; repeated inline-styled row markup not extracted into a Blade component.

security.evidence: All ids re-resolved via $this->entity->queues()/memberships()->findOrFail, so foreign ids give 404; accessQueue/accessGrants derived from scoped lookup (Queues.php:220-227); waiting list checks Gate 'call' (Serve.php:355); output escaped with {{ }}; rate limit on successful calls. Weaknesses: `mode` unvalidated (Serve.php:390 `CallMode::from($this->mode)` → 500 on tamper); grantAccess/revokeAccess (Queues.php:193-207) do not call $this->authorize and rely solely on the action; id properties (viewingQueueId, accessQueueId, editingQueueId) are neither validated nor locked; public helper methods are callable endpoints.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files: no feature tests for the routes, no unauthorized-call or tamper tests for any Livewire action, despite conventions requiring them for every component.

simplicity.evidence: Direct component code reusing actions and policies. Minor redundancy: `$this->reset('name'); $this->name = '';` (Queues.php:78-79), `$queue->fresh()` right after findOrFail (Queues.php:173), duplicated ValidationException-to-addError loops (Queues.php:68-73, 135-140), viewingQueue() duplicated inline in render (Queues.php:209-216 vs 231-233).

readability.evidence: Names are clear and methods short, but viewingQueue() is dead code (Queues.php:209), untyped `$id` parameters unlike sibling style, broken indentation in routes/web.php:53 `    Route::middleware(...)` that Pint would flag, and long inline style attributes repeated in views (queues.blade.php:135, serve.blade.php:40).

scope.evidence: Changes serve the task; small unrelated edits: aria-label additions to pre-existing Members buttons/selects (members.blade.php:31,40,59,134,138,159,161) and the whitespace change at routes/web.php:53.

issues.explanation: No Pest tests ship with two new Livewire components and the Members tabs, violating the mandatory TDD rule and the Livewire definition of done (unauthorized-call and tamper tests per action).
`mode` is a client-writable public property with no validation; a tampered value makes CallMode::from throw a ValueError (500) instead of a validation error.
User-input properties `name`, `renameName` (and Serve's `mode`, `selectedQueueId`) lack #[Validate] and $this->validate(), contrary to the Livewire security policy rule 1.
grantAccess/revokeAccess do not call $this->authorize('manageAccess', $queue) themselves, relying only on the action, while policy rule 3 requires authorization inside every public method.
Internal helpers callableQueues, waitingTickets, selectedQueue and viewingQueue are public, exposing them as callable endpoints against rule 5.
closeQueue() does not reset accessQueueId/managingAccess, so it does not clear every nested state as required.
New routes and pages are not reflected in CHANGELOG.md or docs as the docs-sync convention requires.
viewingQueue() is never used; render() repeats the same lookup inline.
Indentation of the existing Route::middleware group was changed to an inconsistent 4-space offset.
aria-labels were added to pre-existing Members controls that already had visible text, beyond what the task required.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues and Serve Livewire pages, routes, nav links, lang keys and Members tabs, consistently resolving client ids scoped to the entity and delegating writes to the domain actions, so the functional requirements are largely met. However, it ships no tests at all (a blocker under the project's TDD and Livewire definition of done), leaves user-input properties like `mode` and `name` unvalidated (a tampered mode causes a 500), exposes helper methods publicly and skips docs/CHANGELOG, so it needs substantial rework before approval.
